comment: teleport.c u_teleport_mon() 2283 and 2289, rloc() failing on a full level. A debug Priest wishes for a wand of teleportation and level-teleports to the first level of Vlad's Tower (a small no-teleport level), creates a hostile dust vortex that engulfs her, then fills every spot a dust vortex can occupy with '0 peaceful dust vortex' (^G with quantity 0). Zapping the wand inside the engulfer frees her ('You are no longer inside the dust vortex!'); rloc() finds no spot, so m_into_limbo() sends it away (2283). A second zap east hits peaceful dust vortices, and rloc() fails for each (2289); the angered one engulfs her.
